limitations: Main-branch source was inspected through browser; no raw source pin, deployed bytecode proof or independent compilation.

Fixed labels and expected units are hypotheses checked only through views. DAI/USDC addresses match retained Sky evidence; WETH/WBTC match retained Comet basket. USDT is a research-selected Ethereum address, not newly authenticated by source or runtime in this stage.
TokenJar full-balance semantics does not guarantee ordinary token behavior, liquidation, affordability, gas or profit.

sources.finding: Protocol fees flow into a chain-specific TokenJar; a releaser exchanges a threshold resource amount for selected accumulated assets. The example100UNI is illustrative, not an observed threshold.
Directory identifies Firepit and ExchangeReleaser source files.
Constructor delegates to ExchangeReleaser with resource recipient0xdead; no override of the post-release hook is shown.

External release(uint256,address[],address) checks nonce and at most20assets, transfers threshold resource units from caller to resource recipient, asks TokenJar to release to caller-chosen recipient, emits event and runs an empty default hook. Public path requires the resource balance/allowance; source alone does not establish a fill or deployment match.
Only the active releaser may invoke TokenJar release. For each selected asset the contract reads its own balance and transfers any nonzero amount. Owner can change releaser; native ETH is accepted.
RESOURCE and RESOURCE_RECIPIENT immutable; threshold is mutable by designated thresholdSetter, which owner can change. Exact debit is threshold native resource units, with no assumed USD valuation.

Call requires supplied nonce equal to stored nonce and increments before body. This equality protects against stale order but does not guarantee inclusion, reserve inventory, or stop a competing caller from landing first.
